name: Karl von Randow
role: Creator of Camera+, Charles Proxy, and Vee
bio: Back in the olden days Karl was co-founder of Camera+, which sold over 12 million copies on the App Store. More recently he created Vee for Video—an app for quickly shooting, editing and sharing video. He is also the creator of Charles Proxy—a popular desktop app for observing an app’s network traffic—and co-founder of Letterboxd—a social website and app for movie lovers. Karl likes creating things.
